# =========================================================================
#  BlueBird - complete dependency list (exported from the real environment)
# =========================================================================
#  Environment : Python 3.8.3 on Windows
#  Generated by: tools/deps_report.py --write  (reads importlib.metadata)
#
#  NOTE: this file is deliberately ASCII-only.  pip reads a requirements file
#  using the ANSI code page on Windows (GBK on a Chinese system), so non-ASCII
#  comments make `pip install -r requirements.txt` fail with
#  UnicodeDecodeError.
#
#  Install everything (runtime + tests + packaging):
#      python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
# =========================================================================

#  LICENCES

#  Read from each distribution's own metadata (License-Expression, License
#  or the OSI classifier); run tools/deps_report.py to re-check them.
#
#  RUNTIME
#      bcrypt                     Apache-2.0
#      cffi                       MIT
#      cryptography               Apache-2.0 OR BSD-3-Clause
#      paramiko                   LGPL-2.1-or-later
#      pycparser                  BSD-3-Clause
#      PyNaCl                     Apache-2.0
#      PyQt5                      GPL-3.0-only
#      PyQt5-Qt5                  LGPL-3.0-only
#      PyQt5_sip                  SIP
#      PyQtWebEngine              GPL-3.0-only
#      PyQtWebEngine-Qt5          LGPL-3.0-only
#      typing_extensions          PSF-2.0
#
#  TEST
#      pyftpdlib                  MIT
#
#  BUILD
#      altgraph                   MIT
#      brotli                     MIT
#      fonttools                  MIT
#      importlib_metadata         Apache-2.0
#      packaging                  Apache-2.0 OR BSD-2-Clause
#      pefile                     MIT
#      pyinstaller                GPL-2.0-or-later WITH Bootloader-exception
#      pyinstaller-hooks-contrib  Apache-2.0 OR GPL-2.0-or-later
#      PyMuPDF                    AGPL-3.0-only
#      pywin32-ctypes             BSD-3-Clause
#      setuptools                 MIT
#      zipp                       MIT
#
#  What this means for distributing BlueBird.exe
#
#  * PyQt5
#      GPL-3.0 or a commercial licence from Riverbank. Distributing the exe
#      under the GPL is what makes this compliant; a closed source build
#      needs the commercial licence.
#  * PyQt5-Qt5
#      the Qt libraries themselves, used under the LGPL option. They are
#      shipped as separate DLLs (dynamic linking), which is the condition
#      the LGPL attaches.
#  * PyMuPDF
#      AGPL-3.0. Used only by tools/build_manual.py to add the manual's
#      table of contents links and bookmarks, so it is a build tool and is
#      not part of the distributed exe.
#  * pyinstaller
#      the bootloader exception is what lets a GPL-2.0 build tool package a
#      program under other terms.
#  * everything else is MIT, BSD, Apache-2.0, PSF or LGPL, all of which
#      only require the licence text to travel with the binaries.
# =========================================================================
